Each Civ1 unit type's traits are registered first in registerRules, one rule per trait with the id civ1-unit:unit/trait/<Unit>/<Trait>. Nothing reads them yet: tests/traitEquivalence checks that every class and leaf-class check they are to replace picks the same units, over all 28 Civ1 types (civ-clone/web-renderer#1008).
